description: AutoPilot runs a Countdown Timer block, which copilot-stop-journey.spec.ts stops while the timer runs. The second turn answers the timer's result: a stopped turn must never ask for it.
title: Stopped timer

turns.text: I will start a short timer first, then answer you when it goes off.

input.input_message: The timer for the stopped turn went off.

turns.text: The timer went off, so here is the rest of my answer.
